{{Article header|deck=How Engineering works and where to find Engineers, blueprints, Experimental Effects, materials, and unlock procedures.}}

'''Engineering''' customises ship modules, suits, and handheld weapons beyond their stock specifications. A modification can strengthen one or more characteristics while imposing trade-offs elsewhere, so the right choice depends on the equipment's job rather than on grade alone.<ref name="frontier-engineers">[https://community.elitedangerous.com/en/theengineersbetadate The Engineers Beta Release Date and Elite Dangerous 1.6], Frontier Developments, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref>

{{Related articles|label=Browse Engineering|[[Engineers]] [[Engineering Blueprints]] [[Experimental Effects]] [[Engineering Materials]] [[Engineer Unlock Guide]] [[:Category:Modules|Modules]] [[Tools and Resources#Engineering and material tracking|Planning tools]]}}

== System overview ==
Ship Engineering connects four subjects:

* An '''[[Engineers|Engineer]]''' operates a fixed workshop, has access requirements, and offers a defined set of modifications at specific maximum grades.
* An '''[[Engineering Blueprints|Engineering Blueprint]]''' changes a compatible module's statistics. Blueprint articles list benefits, penalties, material costs, grade ranges, compatibility, and Engineer availability.
* '''[[Engineering Materials]]''' pay for modifications. Ship Engineering uses raw, manufactured, and encoded materials stored outside normal cargo racks.
* An '''[[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]]''' adds a separate specialised property to an already engineered module. A module normally carries one Experimental Effect at a time, and compatibility depends on the module and modification family.<ref name="fandom-experimental">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Experimental_Effect Experimental Effect], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref>

For a module's stock classes, ratings, compatibility, behaviour, and limitations, use its module article. Blueprint and Experimental Effect articles describe the Engineering changes. Complete builds and ordered upgrade routes are covered by the relevant Field Procedures.

== Engineer access and reputation ==
An Engineer may need to be discovered, contacted through a referral, or approached only after a rank, reputation, travel, activity, or delivery requirement is met. Reaching the workshop can still leave a separate unlock payment or task to complete. Each Engineer article lists the exact discovery, meeting, unlock, version, service, grade, and direct-referral details.

Ship Engineers use reputation to open higher modification grades. Some reputation can be earned through Engineering work, while particular Engineers also accept activities associated with their specialty. Exact methods vary by Engineer.

The [[Engineers]] directory provides the full roster and referral map. [[Engineer Unlock Guide]] covers practical preparation and the order of operations.

== Blueprints, grades, and trade-offs ==
Most ship blueprints run from Grade 1 through Grade 5. Higher grades push the modification farther from stock and use higher-grade materials, but a higher grade is not automatically the right result for every build. Applying a grade can require more than one modification roll; each roll consumes the listed materials and advances that grade's result. Power draw, thermal load, mass, integrity, distributor demand, range, and other statistics can move in opposing directions.<ref name="inara-blueprint-example">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/135/ Life Support — Shielded blueprint], Inara, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref>

A blueprint applies only to compatible equipment, and Engineers can differ in the maximum grade they offer. Use [[Engineering Blueprints]] for blueprint records, the relevant module page for stock specifications, and the individual Engineer page for workshop availability.

== Pinned blueprints and Remote Workshop ==
A commander can pin one ship blueprint at each Engineer's workshop. A pinned blueprint can then be applied through Remote Workshop at stations and Fleet Carriers that offer the service. Remote application uses the commander's existing access and materials, does not increase Engineer reputation, and cannot add an Experimental Effect.<ref name="fandom-remote">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Remote_Workshop Remote Workshop], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref>

Pinning does not unlock an Engineer or grant access to unsupported grades. Changing the pinned blueprint requires another visit to that Engineer.

== Materials and traders ==
Ship Engineering materials are divided into three inventories:

* '''Raw materials''' are elements and minerals recovered from surface prospecting, mining, missions, and other material sources.
* '''Manufactured materials''' are components obtained from salvage, signal sources, missions, and destroyed ships.
* '''Encoded materials''' are data acquired from scans, wakes, data points, missions, and signal sources.

Material Traders exchange materials within one of those three types. Exchange rates depend on grade and material family; moving upward in grade or across families costs more than trading downward within a family.<ref name="fandom-trader">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Material_Trader Material Trader], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref> [[Engineering Materials]] provides the material index and material-specific acquisition links; dedicated procedures cover complete gathering routes.

== Ship and Odyssey Engineering ==
Ship Engineering modifies installed ship equipment through graded blueprints and optional Experimental Effects. It is available in both Live and Legacy, although newer blueprints and equipment can differ between versions.

Odyssey Engineering modifies suits and handheld weapons and is available only in Live. It uses its own goods, assets, data, upgrade path, and Engineer network. Odyssey modifications occupy available equipment modification slots rather than using the ship blueprint Grade 1–5 progression.<ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara, accessed 2026-09-10.</ref>

The [[Engineers]] directory separates ship and Odyssey Engineers and labels Live-only availability.
